definitions.supplemental: Cf. O. H. Ger. un-giwon inusitatus, insolens, novus.

quotations.old_english: Micel gedál is on ðam mægene ðæs ðe sié gewin (-wun?) þrowungum and ðæs ðe sié ungewuna swelcum þingum

source_text: un-gewuna; adj. Unaccustomed, unused :-- Micel gedál is on ðam mægene ðæs ðe sié gewin (-wun?) þrowungum and ðæs ðe sié ungewuna swelcum þingum, Lchdm. ii. 84, 19. [Cf. O. H. Ger. un-giwon inusitatus, insolens, novus.)
